[[File:BlueSphereTransportEnclosure.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Blue Sphere Transport Enclosure Vehicle.]]
A '''Blue Sphere Transport Enclosure Vehicle''' were vehicles created by the [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] that were able to travel across the far reaches of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at high speeds. During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Gree traders on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] provided such vehicles to spacers that bought them from the unknown aliens.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
